source_definition: A source instance is a conjunction of clauses of three distinct unnegated variables. A valid assignment gives both truth values to every clause; an infeasible instance returns NO-SOLUTION.
target_definition: The target is a connected bipartite graph of diameter at most five. A witness is a nontrivial vertex bipartition in which every vertex has exactly one neighbor across the cut; otherwise the output is NO-SOLUTION.
required_result: Construct deterministic polynomial-time maps F and G: F sends every legal source instance to a legal target instance, and G(x,y) is a valid source output for every valid output y of F(x). Preserve the stated threshold, domain and promises. The requested complexity conclusion is NP-hardness for the stated target problem.
